metadata.description: Personal Agent Skills for Cursor, Claude, Codex, and other Agent Skills hosts. Install the full user-skills plugin, or pick domain packs. Companion MCPs are bundled only when the server lives in this repo.

plugins.name: user-skills
plugins.description: Every user-level skill in this repository, plus the skill-lab MCP when Node deps are installed. Use this for a single Cursor install that tracks git. Prefer domain packs when you want independent enable/disable.

plugins.name: user-skills-engineering
plugins.description: Git, CI/CD, testing, repo operations, and software architecture skills. No MCP bundled; use host git/CI tools. Pair with user-skills-skill-lab when authoring skills.

plugins.name: user-skills-product
plugins.description: Specs, roadmaps, planning, value propositions, and Linear PM workflows. Does not bundle Linear MCP; install Cursor's official Linear plugin alongside this pack.

plugins.name: user-skills-design
plugins.description: Brand, design systems, UI/UX, diagrams, slides, and visual generation skills. Does not bundle Figma or image-model MCPs; those stay host-configured.

plugins.name: user-skills-documents
plugins.description: Office files, PDF conversion, technical writing, and documentation governance. Word/Excel MCPs stay host-configured when those skills need them.

plugins.name: user-skills-research
plugins.description: Deep research and research-analysis workflows. Uses host web/fetch tools; no extra MCP bundled.

plugins.name: user-skills-skill-lab
plugins.description: Skill authoring, validation, and catalog workflows (skill-set). Prefer the full user-skills plugin if you also want the in-repo skill-lab MCP, which must see the whole skills tree.

plugins.name: user-skills-personal
plugins.description: Personal-life skills that should stay off coding agents. Requires Notion MCP on the host for physio-fitness-coach persistence.
